avis.titre: the best ever hands down forever
avis.texte: Literally the best sunscreen ive ever used. I've tried literal dozens of sun screens for my face and this is the only one that didnt burn and break out once I got sweaty. PLEASE if you care about me do not ever stop selling this. In fact please make it in giant pump bottles. Im begging you. Ive used so many bottles of this

I am loving this sunscreen! The texture is a bit on the dry oil gel, similar to a primer like the smashbox the original, however it dries pretty matte (but not dull). I add translucent powder on top and it keeps my face from looking oily even more than when I'm not wearing any sunscreen. I used to use wither la roche uvmune or isntree hyaluronic acid on either serum or gel (still like the isntree ones a lot, but might prefer this sun bum one!?). I might be switching to this one! Perfect for the harsh summer weather in Boston, I do a lot of fieldwork!
Love this product … it's so silky soft. I wear u see my make up
This sunscreen blended beautifully! I enjoyed using it, the texture was lovely, and it applied very well under my makeup. I likely rebuy this when I run out.

Great sunscreen gel, no cast or sheen after applying. SPF gels are pricey in general, but this one is much more reasonably priced than the other ones out there. And I find it worth it to not have that feeling of heaviness and greasiness on my face from regular spf creams. I switched over to this from unseen and it is the same quality for about half the price! I have noticed that it can get kind of watery if I don't shake it up before use, but that's not a problem for me. I also have sensitive skin and have done well with this for several months now.
It's not greasy at all, which I love. Goes on easily and stands up to southern Louisiana heat and humidity.

avis.titre: This one is the best one
avis.texte: Best sunscreen ever, doesn't feel like you are wearing sunscreen and doesn't make the skin oily after all day of use
My most favorite facial sunscreen! You hardly know it's there.
not sticky, super comfortable to wear, no overwhelming scent, great for wearing on my job.

The consistency is perfect, feels just like primer. I have combination/oily skin, I've been wearing it every day for 3 months and this doesn't clog my pores. It's lightweight, not heavy on my skin. Nice and smooth feel. You can definitely put make up on top, my make up doesn't crease or cake.
This is AMAZING. Truly haven't found something perfect after literally buying 25 others to test out. The GOAT do not ever discontinue.

avis.titre: I would buy this again if it didn't cause my eyes to sting
avis.texte: This sunscreen is the only one I have tried so far that sits comfortably on my skin. It doesn't feel oily or sticky, it melts into my skin flawlessly. It's scent is minimal, but still noticeable. The only issue I had was that by the end of the day, if I rubbed my eyes or sweat too much, my eyes would sting a little. I heard that this could be an issue due to it being a chemical sunscreen, but I still wanted to try it out. I love the product other than that one issue, so I cannot continue using it.

The consistency is perfect, feels just like primer. I have combination/oily skin, I wear it every day and this doesn't clog my pores. It's lightweight, not heavy on my skin. Nice and smooth feel. You can definitely put make up on top, it doesn't crease or cake.

this sunscreen was peeling. i would wait ten minutes between my moisturizer and sunscreen and even then when i began application the sunscreen would immediately start to pill up. i had to wipe my hands between sections of my face and wipe off the flaky resedue. it does get you matte, but only for a bit. after one hour my t-zone would be so shiny and oily. this sunscreen is not good and too much of a hassle to keep up with. do nit waste your money on it

This sunscreen is a great texture. Only problem is if it seeps into your eyes, it burns really bad. Do not put this under your eyes or on your eyelids. If it didnt burn then this woild be a awesome sunscreen!
Great for applications over and over again. Goes on smoothly and does the job!

I bought this sunscreen before i realized it has 5 oils including coconut oil which makes me nervous due to the high chance to clog pores. But i decided to still try it and the texture is really nice. I love that it is at least SPF 50, clear and easy to blend yet feels very hydrating and light. I love that it's water resistant most likely from the oils which makes it very smooth.

I have been using this sunscreen for about a week now, and i am loving it! I have extremely oily skin, so it's important to me to find a sunscreen that doesnt feel heavy or greasy. It blends into my skin very easily and wears well under makeup. It hasn't broke my skin out either! A lot of people have commented on the smell of it, but i do not notice any smell while applying it to my face. I will definitely keep using this sunscreen!!

Compact travel friendly packaging helped keep my bags light and sunburn at bay during my visit to Costa Rica. Loved the clear gel face sunscreen - goes on effortlessly with no residue or post sunscreen acne! The signature 50spf is compact and worked great. Loved the design with no cap to misplace!
love this sunscreen moisturizer; anytime i can use a 2-in-1 product (or 3-in-1) that doesn't irritate my redhead sensitivities is a big plus
This sunscreen changed my life, im normally sensitive to sunscreen and this one is perfect

I hate dewy sunscreen. Ive tried all big popular brands (supergoop, shisedo, elta md, etc) and this is my got to. I reach for this spf over all the others beacuse it feels light on my skin and has a matte finish. I have acne prone skin and feel/ look gross with that dewy shiny finish. This sun bum fel is simliler to the super goop unseen but feels breathable on my skin. I give it a good shake and have no problem getting the recommended amount on. I see a few reviews say it smells bad- but i dont think it has any scent. I wear this everyday.

Love this product; hate the packaging. It's impossible to squeeze product out after a while. I've resorted to using a knife to cut the tubes open - and there's always SO MUCH product left when I open it up. Would love to see this offered in an easier container.
I used this not only on my self but my kids as well we went to an amusement park and it's hard to keep your children cover especially their faces this made it so easy!

I am 57 years old and can state unequivocally that I've tried at least 50 daily, under makeup sunscreens and Sun Bum Daily gel wins hands down. It glides on deliciously smoothly and stays matte. It is not sticky or oily in the least and I apply makeup right after. I purchased it for a beach vacation and now wear it every day on my face, neck, and chest. I stock up on it to make sure I don't run out. If I could give 10 stars I would!

This makes my skin feel so velvety smoothe and stays matte. It dries immediately and spreads so easy and is completely clear. Best sunscreen I have ever used. I abandoned my old SPF and switched to this and got the matching body spf. Would love to see this same gel formula in a night moisturizer gel too. 😊 I am now a sun bum lover. I even went out and got their aftersun lotion, kids SPF stick for my kiddos, and hair products after falling in love with this SPF. 😊♥️

I really like this formula. Reminds me of Supergoop but less silicone-y and my skin felt like it breathed more. My issue was the scent. I am normally not sensitive to smells but this smelled like something spoiled and it didnt go away quickly. Like burning rubber and cat puke. Surprised more reviews havent commented on it.

avis.titre: makeup girlies you'll need to try!!
avis.texte: this sunscreen basically acts like a silcone primer that smoothes and fills in prores while having a gripping affect. your skin just feels so immaculate thats the only word to describe it. i would moisturize your skin thoroughly and wait 5 minutes to let it absorb then wait at least 5 minutes before putting on any kind of makeup, you wont be disappointed.

This daily SPF gel is lightweight, glides on easily and doesn't give your face the typical white sunscreen cast. It comes out of the bottle a little watery and then feels like silk as your rubbing it into your skin. I love that this has a high SPF than most facial sunscreens.

If you've ever tried the Supergoop invisible sunscreen, this is practically the same thing for HALF the cost! Though highly raved about, I personally never enjoyed the Supergoop formula because the heavy silicone texture was off-putting and did nothing for my dry skin. It just felt like I was wearing a slippery silicone mask all day. I prefer dewy SPF lotions for this reason. They provide hydration and protection all in one. However, I love Sun Bum sunscreens so I still wanted to give this a try! The term "gel" is slightly misleading because it makes you think of a cooling gel consistency which this is not. This is definitely that same silicone texture, but the formula has a more hydrating quality to it. The silicone base gives it a mattifying texture which makes it invisible on the skin. The more exciting part: this is weightless and DOES NOT BURN THE EYES! I have yet to find a single U.S. chemical sunscreen that doesn't burn my eyes into oblivion. I don't know how this formula would hold up on the beach or under extreme sweating/activity, but I fully recommend (as it's advertised) for daily wear or under makeup. Sun Bum is killing it!
This is hands down the best-looking sunscreen I've ever tried. Unlike other gel sunscreens, this one doesn't pill.

This contains coconut oil as one of the first ingredients. If you are easily acne prone and/or prone to clogged pores stay away. Coconut oil is HIGHLY comedogenic. It would be nice if they created a facial sunscreen that is noncomedogenic.

I used sunscreen everyday. Feels good under makeup! It almost has a matte feeling - sorta like a primer. Definitely not the average face sun CREAM. Gel is in the name, gel is exactly the consistency! I would buy again!
It does not smell good. Especially vs all of their other products. Left a very oily/greasy sheen behind. Ended up taking it back.

I have been looking for a while for a sunscreen that is waterproof for the face. I usually end up having to put the body one a little on my face after going into the water. This one is also a clear gel so there is no white cast!
I have combo skin and it feels good on my skin. Not too heavy and doesn't look oily. Ingredients aren't too too bad so I'm pretty pleased! Love having a moisturizer that has spf in it!

I received this product free of charge from Influenster and sun bum in exchange for my honest review. This product seems to work well. What is extra lovely about it compared to others is that it dries matte and even makes a fair makeup primer. Easily accessible and much less than fancier brands. I highly recommend to anyone.

This comes out of the bottle so nice. The bottle is actually cute, too. Love the faux wooden top. The best part is how it feels when it's goes on. It goes on really smoothly under makeup or when you are having a makeup free day. There is no white residue or anything. Will repurchase.

I recommend this to people who don't like traditional sunscreen. It's nice because it applies on top of the skin and doesn't soak in immediately. It acts like a barrier and did not disturb makeup that sat on top of it all day; except with oily skin after a day of work it was needing touch ups. I was disappointed that it didn't smell like other products from this brand. I love the tropical smell.

I think this is definitely more of a summer moisturizer because it's VERY light. I love that it is spf 50 and sheer but for someone who lives in a very dry climate and it being winter in addition to having very dry skin it just isn't for me. It looks and feels as if I put absolutely nothing on as well as makes my skin look matte. Which is not what I want. I personally need a very rich moisturizer that makes my skin look hydrated. I definitely will try it again in the summer.
Light weight sunscreen that is great for everyday wear. Works well under makeup and is not too greasy or sticky. Perfect for daily protection from the sun

this smells great and it work great under my makeup while keeping me safe from the sun it also has no white cast due to it being a gel which also makes it really easy to rub in and apply. it doesn't make my makeup pill or anything which is an issue i've run into before. the gel is very light weight and doesn't feel greasy which is also really important to me.

I received this product for free from Influenster and Sunbum for my honest review. This face sunscreen is an interesting texture due to it being a gel. I do like the cooling effect it gives, but it makes my face feel a little sticky.

Even though we are in the winter season, I live in Cali and the weather is unpredictable. I had a chance to try this sun bum daily gel, when I went to my sons soccer games. It's non greasy, consistency in the middle between runny and not thick. It applied and absorbed really well. I liked how it didn't leave any white residue like other sunscreen moisturizers. My only con would have to be the scent, I just didn't like it.

This product was fine. But doesn't make sense if you plan on wearing makeup as it calls for you to apply every two hours. The rubbed in nicely and didn't have an intense smell which is nice since it on your face. But the fact that you have to continuously reapply doesn't make sense for my lifestyle.
i really enjoy this sunscreen! i really enjoy this sunscreen for everyday. it's nice and lightweight! overall totally recommend!!!!!!!!!!!!
"Definitely something you will always need to have anytime you're outside all day long!! Definitely gonna add it to the beach bag for vacation!!"

I'm always hesitant to try new sunscreen because I'm always nervous they'll make me breakout. When I first tried using this product, the texture seemed too oily - almost like I didn't shake it well enough before using but it proved me wrong. It was very lightweight and soaked in quickly without leaving any residue or flashback. Even though it felt oily to me at first, my skin wasn't greasy or shiny at all but still felt very moisturized. I didn't get a chance to try this under makeup but I'm sure it would hold up well since it was so lightweight and smooth. I think y'all should give it a try! :)

I have a really hard time finding SPFs that work for me and this one was okay. I definitely have others that I prefer and I don't know if I'll be reaching for this one often but I didn't dislike it. Most sunscreens burn my eyes and this one did after a few hours.

Tested and recommended. I loved it. It didn't cause me any effect. The skin on my face is very delicate and almost all products cause me allergies, block pores and cause imperfections. I'm dropping this one 10/10.

I enjoyed that the product is a clear gel and is thin and lightweight. I think this is easy to use every day especially if you live somewhere very sunny. It did not irritate my skin, but I did feel that it caused increased congestion in my pores over time.

About this product I love the texture it absorbs very quick and it does not feel heavy on my skin! It leaves the skin so glowy I just use two lines for all my face as shown in the pic, I just love it! One of my fav

Quite elegant finish if you already have decent skin. It can leave a bit of white cast for not pale white skin tones, needs to rub in well. Don't sit well on top of many skin care layers though. It pills on me a couple times. Sun protection is great though. I however don't like the smell very much.
This gel is so light and absorbs into my skin super fast! I love that it is not like every other sunscreen! It also doesn't leave the skin chalky like traditional sunscreen!
This gel has a nice cooling feel to it and it's so velvety soft tbh. I like it a lot. And I normally don't wear sunscreen on my face but this makes me want to

This sunscreen gel is a game changer for me when it comes to wanting to apply sunscreen. It's not colored, it's clear, it's not sticky, it absorbs in immediately, and it leaves your skin feeling soft and moisturized, kind of like a makeup primer. You can absolutely wear makeup naturally over this product. Love!!! Also, great price point for a product like this.

I got this to try from Influenster, hoping it would be a good daily option for a winter sunscreen that was moisturizing but not oily. My genuine opinion is that its really good! I'm fair skinned so I need to use sunscreen even in winter, but I'm excited to try this in the summer too.

This moisturizer is a great gel consistency, good applicator and I like that it has spf 50. It has a slight sunscreen smell but otherwise unscented. It's not the best form of moisturizer for my skin specifically because it's so dry, and the gel consistency doesn't moisturize to the level I need, especially in the winter. However I can see myself using this more in the summer as it's lightweight.

First of all, I absolutely love the way this product makes my skin feel! It leaves my face feeling so much softer than my usual moisturizer/sunscreen combo, and smells great too! My only complaint is that it may have made my face break out; however, my skin is particularly sensitive and I can't be 100% sure the gel is to blame. Overall, I will definitely give this product another chance, and definitely recommend it for those without acne prone skin.
I am an avid daily sunscreen user and this is fabulous! I love that it goes on clear, making it easier to apply under makeup. I would absolutely buy again!
It's a super goop dupe, has a silicone feel to it without much of a scent. You need more than you'd think but it makes a great primer for foundation.

I liked that the sunscreen has a high SPF. It was easy to use, did not have that "sunscreen smell" and it didn't leave my skin feeling sticky like some other sunscreens. It provides good coverage and helps protect your skin against the sun.
This spf is such a great one! It's lightweight, perfect for daytime, spf 50, has a great price point, AND doesn't leave a white cast on me. I can't ask for more!

I got this complimentary from influenster, its a gel sunscreen but when applied it feels more like an oil, it absorbs fast and doesn't make my face feel greasy, doesnt leave a white cast and so far it doesn't sting my eyes, haven't tried to apply make up after so when i do I'll update my review to see how they interact

This lightweight spf is a great option for a daily sunscreen. It has no white cast and blends in easily. I also like using this under makeup, as its a bit tacky and works nicely as a primer. Definitely recommend trying this one out!
Feels a bit oily when I first put it on but then absorbs into the skin. Feels really lightweight and fine. Nothing too noticeable and not heavy on the skin. Also noticed it was unscented
Works great at protecting from the sun while moisturizing. Doesn't dry my skin out and seems like absorb evenly. Hasn't caused irritation on my skin. Good smell

avis.titre: Nice for people who don't like oily sunscreen!
avis.texte: "This product was really different compared to other products that I've tried. It does remind me of super goop matte sunscreen which is great as a primer. It is easy to put on and has a thin silicone like texture. This is a great product to bring on trips and wear under make up or loan to hold back the oils. ￼"
I never received the product, but when I used to work at Ulta a lot of people would come and buy this product. Recurring customers means they are doing something good. So definitely try it.

I have had many sun bum products and they are yet to fail me! I have dry skin all year long so anything that comes in gel form I'm all about! I find this to be much more hydrating than a lotion that ends up creasing and cracking. It felt light and hydrating both of which I'm all about! I took it along with me to vacation and remained burn free! I highly recommend. I received these products for free from Influenster and brand(s) in exchange for my honest review.
I love the way sun bum smells. It's very refreshing as being on the beach. I appreciate the fact it's an SPF 50 to protect the face/skin from sun damage.

"This gel is super cool! It has a very light fragrance. Fragrance is the same as the other products but it is very limited which is a huge plus for those who are sensitive to smells but love sun bum. The gel is clear, goes on smooth and feels light when wearing it. No break outs have happened so that's good for sensitive skin types. 50spf is perfect for face coverage and I love that its higher than most. I did not try it with makeup so not sure how it feels/holds up with that but I would recommend this to my friends who wanted a daily spf . I received this free in exchange for a honest review."
This product wasn't my favorite. It's a clear sunscreen with a gel like texture, but it leaves my skin feeling oily. It's great because it has SPF 50 but wouldn't use it again.

It's a…a gel sunscreen…moisturi…huh??…I was definitely confused a bit when I first put it on, I was expecting sticking to apply and to end up with an oily or thick residue of some sort. I was pleasantly surprised when I was wrong, it's not sticky at all, goes a lot like a serum just a bit different consistency, then it's just there like it soaks in pretty quickly, there's next to no dry time and it has a matte/satin finish. And y'all it's a freaking sunscreen to boot!! Definitely my new go to for daily moisturizing and sun protection!! Love it!
I've never used it and the first time is did I like it. I don't use it daily because I have one that I'm using and it's doing me justice. This spf is great does wonders

Overall seems like an ok product but i didn't like the texture.silky feeling texture and it made me feel that my skin was not clean, or feeling not clean. I wouldn't buy and I stop using it because my face started to break out
The daily 50 face gel is great. It feels hydrating and very quickly absorbs, there's no white cast residue and no oily feeling. Protects great and easy to pack.
I found it a bit oily for me, and the scent wasn't for me but my partner really liked it. I think he will be buying this product once he finishes this bottle

I had never used a clear sunscreen before, so I was not sure what I was going to think of this product. I love it, and I think I'm going to be adding it to my permanent rotation for sunscreens. ￼ I was surprised that there was no fragrance, and I'm surprise that I actually really like that there's no fragrance. I have sensitive, dry skin, and this sunscreen has not irritated it at all. It went on smooth and feels light, and because it's clear there's no white streaky weirdness when you put it on. Overall, I think this is an excellent product to use if you have dry skin and are trying to protect yourself from the sun￼ :)
This sunscreen is good for every skin type people. I usually use it when I go to beach cause it has SPF 50 which helps me not to get sun burn . I recommend this product

I really wanted to love this gel SPF but it didn't hit the mark for me. It's nice in the sense that it goes on clear and had decent absorption into my skin. The one downside I found was it left a silicone like feel to my face, which I don't love for non-makeup wearing days but worked okay under makeup. I didn't hate it but definitely have other SPFs I'd reach for first.

"I received this item for review. The packaging is cute and functional; I recommend shaking the product with every use. The Sunbum SPF moisturizer is really nice. It hydrates the skin without stickiness, leaving a silicone feel behind, like a silicone-based primer. It lasts well throughout the day without breaking up my makeup (most silicone based products do). This product doesn't have the regular sunscreen smell; it has a little bit of a chemical smell that dissipates after application. I don't go tanning and it's November-December so the SPF is challening to test, but I haven't run into any issues so far."

I did hesitated about try this product because most of the sunscreens on the market makes my face oily fast and also pimples start to appear, but this one is another thing is perfect for a daily use and goes amazing with make up.

I really love this stuff. It applies so easy and it works really well underneath my makeup. I am not sure how effective it is because we are in the fall and winter months and there has been very little sun. It has the consistency of Neosporin. There is not much of a smell but if anything it just reminds me of Vaseline but not as shiny.

Wow before this I never wore sunscreen because it's too many steps before putting foundation. But this one is clear no white cast and my foundation goes on smoothly. And as the time passes my foundation doesn't melt away or start peeling. I truly recommend this to everyone….

I've been on a sunscreen journey this year, trying as many as I could. I was always curious about Sun Bum so I was excited to try this out, especially when I saw that this was a gel. Unfortunately I wasn't a fan of this. It felt like this product was packed with silicones, I unfortunately can't say for sure if it has silicones in the formula because the ingredients are not listed on the bottle (aside from the actives) and I threw the packaging out and can't find the product anywhere online. It felt kind of heavy on my skin and but I did like that it was a gel formula. If you don't mind silicone feeling products you would probably love this and I think it would make a good base for makeup.

This is a great sunscreen for people that doesn't like greasy lotions that leave either white casting or grease face when wearing sunscreen. This is also a great for traveling as it's compact enough to put in my purse.

Sun Bum daily gel sunscreen moisturizer was quickly absorbed in my skin and there was no greasy or oily feeling. The small nozzled tube made it easy to get the desired amount of gel sunscreen moisturizer. After the application, I couldn't even tell that anything was applied to the skin visibly but the dry skin was well moisturized.

One of the products that I always want to have in my routine is sunscreen. This is one of the best I've tried, I like its formula, it adheres very quickly, very moisturizing and what I liked the most is gel without a strong aroma. It doesn't leave you lumps and very soft for every day.

I received this for free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I really like this sunscreen! I have dry skin, so I couldn't really use it alone as a moisturizer/sunscreen in one, but it layers nicely with all of my products, including my face makeup. It feels good on, almost like a silicone primer, which I enjoy the texture of. It's very soft and lightweight. There's not a lot of fragrance to it either, which is very nice. Will definitely be purchasing for myself when I run out.

"One of the things I love about this face gel is its lightweight and non-greasy formula. It absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving any residue or a heavy feeling. This makes it perfect for everyday use, especially under makeup. The SPF 50 in this face gel provides high-level sun protection, shielding your skin from harmful UVA and UVB rays. It's important to protect our skin from the sun's damaging effects, and this face gel does a great job at that."
Love this daily gel to protect my face from the sun! It's super lightweight and really absorbs into my skin. I've added this to my daily routine and I'm not turning back!
I have been looking for a sun screen that doesn't feel greasy on the skin and this is it! I like the gel and how it doesn't leave the skin looking white and greasy all day.
Very lightweight but hydrating spf. The gel formula wears nicely under makeup or by itself. It absorbs fast and doesn't leave a film over my skin.

"This is THE best face sunscreens I ever tried for my type of skin. I consider my skin oily but sometimes a combination of both depending on the weather and, after applying the sunscreen I couldn't feel any on my face, which I usually can feel with another ones. 10/10 buying it again and recommending it"

I received this product for free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. This was my first time using a gel face spf. It is a clear product and easy to clean off. The texture was almost like a face matte primer when applied right into my skin. I had my wife try makeup over it and she had no problems. It gives both UVA and UVB protection and it is free of oxybenzone and octinoxate. I will definitely continue to use this gel on the daily and I highly recommend giving this Sun Bum SPF 50 face gel a try!
I like the consistency and sheerness. It goes on clear and rubs in sheer. Don't love the ingredients, some harmful ones. The smell is strong too so I couldn't wear on my face.
I am a huge fan of Sun Bum! This product has clean ingredients, works well, and this particular product is great on the face! Doesn't cake up, rubs in nicely, and most importantly, avoided sun burn!
Love this SPF gel. I have oily skin so I tend to use products that are moisturizing and gel like in texture. This seemed to work great, as I always incorporate spf in my daily skin routine.

I am in love with how this gel feels on my face. I've always hated sunscreen because of the smell and texture feeling it leaves behind, and this face gel solves the entire problem. Extra bonus that it comes in spf 50, most things I've found that feel good on my skin were always a much lower spf. Loving this, very much something I'd recommend!
I think this will be better for water activity/beach days since I don't mind texture products when I'm dipping in the water. Love that it's water resistant.

Really like this and the consistency and feel. It definitely is a feel, it comes out quick and is very spreadable. More runny. But it spreads nice and leaves skin so soft. Finish almost reminds me of unseen sunscreen. Has very very light scent like sunscreens

I love this sun bun face sunscreen! It's a gel so it sinks into the skin easily. The fact that it's clear is such a plus! I hate when sunscreen gives me a white cast. This sunscreen isn't sticky at all and kind of reminds me of the Murad sunscreen. I definitely recommend.

This sunscreen is entirely clear. I was surprised to find that there was no color or tint whatsoever. No white cast and the formula rubs in quickly. I wore this for a few days and the only thing that bothered me is the formula runs through the day and gets in my eyes and mouth
This sunscreen is ideal for daily use, is water resistant, provides protection for up to 80 minutes of sun exposure, is fragrance-free and contains vitamin E and antioxidants.

I use this product as part of my daily skincare routine. Some people might say it looks greasy, but I think it gives a dewy glow. I like that this sunblock does not leave a white residue. ￼I will buy again. ￼
This was my first time to try sunbum sunscreen. I am surprised how amazing it was. This sunscreen is super lightweight doesn't feel any greasy or heavy on the skin at all.
It does feel sticky or pasty when I apply it on the skin. I like the clear appearance of it. I had never tried this brand till now. So I would definitely recommend it for your sunscreen needs
It's small and tidy so you can bring to travel, not feel sticky when you apply on the face. Good product and must have to protect yourself from sun.

I got this product for my honest opinion and review. I have never used this brand before. This sunscreen is very lightweight. It has a matte finish so it's good for oily skin. I would recommend if you like light and matte finish products.

I am the world's pickiest person when it comes to sunscreen. I have to make sure everything is just right - from the texture, smell. If it leaves a greasy or oily feeling after it's applied, If it absorbs quickly and if it can be worn under makeup. I am so impressed that Sun Bum's Daily Face Gel checks all the boxes for me! It reminds me of a clear primer and it rubs in and adorns so quickly! No scent, not greasy, works excellent under makeup.
I liked reading that is demarro logout tested as my skin is very sensitive. It is water resistant which added a plus to this product. It has SPF 50 that is very good as well

avis.titre: I didn't like the oily feeling after applying
avis.texte: Easy to apply worked great while I was outside all day with my kids! I wish it didn't leave my face feeling oily n nasty after applying then once applied it was kind of tight feeling.

I received this complimentary from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. This sunscreen gel goes on smoothly and a little bit goes a long way, otherwise it starts to feel like there's a layer on top of your skin. Using a thin layer and letting it soak in works great for me!

I never experienced a sunscreen like this! It goes on super smooth with no oily residue. It also did not wash off into my eyes when wet! Would have give it a 5 but the bottle is a bit small for daily use.

I tried this SPF 50 face gel by applying it with a primer before applying the rest of my makeup overtop. It felt like a nice moisturizer and absorbed well into my skin without leaving streaks or marks behind. My makeup applied evenly and smoothly on top of it.

I really liked the texture of this sunscreen very gel like. It lays really nice on the skin & I applied this to my face neck & hands & my skin cooperated with it without irritation & I have sensitive skin.

If you have sensitive skin and are sensitive to chemical SPF or are pregnant/breastfeeding this is not the sunscreen for you! When I chose to participate in this offer I thought I was getting a mineral SPF but to my disappointment it's not. I breakout every time I use chemical SPF so this is not for me. I ended up giving to my husband. I'll update my review once he gives me review. I did pump this onto my hand to feel the consistency and I really didn't like it. It's not so much of gel but more of a silicone primer that leaves that sleek silicone layer and I personally hate that feeling.

Perfect sunscreen! Very moisturizing and lightweight. Im very picky about sunscreens especially on my acne prone skin but i've been testing this out the last week and it's absolutely amazing! Perfect for when you're rushing as well because its a sunscreen and moisturizer in one. Highly recommend!!

This isn't something you see everyday and I've tried many products due to my oily skin but also the freckles that come out in the sun… I'm so happy this product exist especially because it's a moisturizer in one so I really have no excuse if I forget or omit my spf. Not slick, not smelly, not to thick; probably a star under makeup!!

I love this sunscreen no more worries for me that I will look like a Casper right after I apply it . It is very gentle on my skin and weightless . I like this brand other products already but this one definitely one of my favorite

This is a lightweight gel type sunscreen that is transparent and therefore there's no white cast. It does go on a little matte on my skin but honestly this is a great revolution for sunscreen. It also has spf 50 which is crazy !!
